lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a roughly rectangular grid pattern along the mid-to-posterior lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated intensity that align with the vertical columns of the spot grid, particularly noticeable on the mid-body section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel longitudinal ridges showing high-contrast luminance gradients (bright crests over dark troughs) running horizontally along the upper flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The dorsal fin silhouette contains a sparse distribution of high-intensity spots, primarily located on the lower half of the fin's visible surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct dark, localized indentation is visible on the dorsal midline posterior to the first dorsal fin, suggesting a morphological irregularity or healed trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: The caudal fin, positioned in the immediate foreground, exhibits a dense scattering of smaller, lower-contrast luminance points across its entire visible surface area.
